answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in river and nadir lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the dune graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 438 impostors cost 1356 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
